TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS

    name "Build upper body strength within pain-free range"

  PHASE "Phase 1: Foundation & Scapular Stability" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Upper Pull & Scapular":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          scapular_retraction 3x12 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          external_rotation 3x10 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds

          chest_stretch 90s
          lat_stretch 90s

          prone_T 3x8 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 90s
          shoulder_stretch 90s
